entries.subject: FW: Support Call# 11701239: NHS Pension tiers new pay ranges
entries.body:
Morning,

I can’t recall whether you still need to be made aware of changes to the NHS pension tier bandings for your reporting, but Linda has just informed of the April 2026 updates.

The employee contribution percentages remain unchanged, but the pensionable salary bands have been updated.

Please see the details below and the attached information. I’ve also asked Linda to review the weekly and monthly thresholds I’ve calculated before I enter these into the UAT environment (UOXU) for testing.

 

Best wishes,

Michael

 

 

From: Michael O'Sullivan <michael.osullivan@admin.ox.ac.uk> 
Sent: 12 August 2026 08:44
To: Linda Howse <linda.howse@admin.ox.ac.uk>
Cc: Tracy Roberts <tracy.roberts@admin.ox.ac.uk>; Joanna Taylor <joanna.taylor@admin.ox.ac.uk>
Subject: Support Call# 11701239: NHS Pension tiers new pay ranges

 

Hi Linda,

 

When we update the rates into the system we need to state the weekly and monthly thresholds.  I have set these out on the attached, please could you check over for me to ensure this is correct.  The rates actually changing are highlighted in orange, although I need to input all the tiers still in order.  

 

 



 

Best wishes,

Michael

 

Michael O’Sullivan

Senior Functional Analyst

 

HR Systems |People Department

4 Worcester Street, Oxford, OX1 2BX

University of Oxford
